title: 1500美元起家：卖自行车零件，如何做到6.5亿用户？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you think your journey tracks the Indian economy?
segments.zh: 你觉得你的历程与印度经济同步吗？
完全同步。你学到了什么？

segments.en: If I really look at my trajectory and India's trajectory, there is so much in common because I actually put my mind
segments.zh: 回顾我的轨迹和印度的轨迹，有很多共同点，因为我确实用心

segments.en: who can say go with the Indian change that happened.
segments.zh: 谁能说跟上印度发生的变革。

segments.en: Today, India is a continent of consumers.
segments.zh: 如今，印度是一个庞大的消费大陆。

segments.en: You just cannot not be in India. Sonal Bharti Mittal is a household name in India.
segments.zh: 你不能不在印度。苏尼尔·巴蒂·米塔尔在印度家喻户晓。

segments.en: Over three decades, he built a multi-billion-dollar business that touches more than 650 million people across many countries.
segments.zh: 三十多年来，他打造了价值数十亿美元的业务，覆盖多国超过6.5亿人。

segments.en: He says he started off with a $1,500 loan from his father.
segments.zh: 他说自己最初用的是父亲给的1500美元贷款。

segments.en: You started by selling bicycles, right?
segments.zh: 你一开始是卖自行车的，对吧？

segments.en: That's right. It's bicycle parts. Bicycle parts.
segments.zh: 没错。是自行车零件。自行车零件。

segments.en: I didn't have money to make a full bicycle. I was 18. I came out of college and education was not my forte.
segments.zh: 我没钱造一整辆自行车。那时18岁，刚离开学校，读书不是我的强项。

segments.en: I just wanted to get the hell out of there. I come from a town called Ludhiana, which is normally called Manchester of India.
segments.zh: 我只想赶紧离开那里。我来自卢迪亚纳，常被称为印度的曼彻斯特。

segments.en: It's a very industrial town. Very entrepreneur.
segments.zh: 那是个工业城镇，创业氛围浓厚。

segments.en: Very entrepreneur. And the two things that are famous, there are bicycles and a hostry, woolen garments.
segments.zh: 创业氛围浓厚。当地有两样东西出名：自行车和羊毛针织品。
